restaurant_name: CSDC Dental Clinic สาขาหลังมช
text:
Unsatisfactory service and overpriced, and suspected cheating ...

Me and my wife found good google comments for this clinic, so we called to book teeth cleaning but was told only 4 or 5 pm are available in the coming week. We book on Wednesday hoping no too busy and can have better service.
When we arrived, we saw a young man coming into the clinic and followed "some kind of instruction" of the nurse staff to enter an open partitioned place with a surgery chair. We later found out that's the place for us.
The overall place doesn't seem to be well maintained. Some areas like the pantary beside the washroom look a bit messy and shouldn't appear in a dental clinic.
We lived in Thailand for almost 20 years. We have visited dental clinic in Phuket and Bangkok may be around 10 times and I must say this is the worst experience. The young man serving us doesn't look professional/skillful and in sometime causing me pain.
Last but not least, when I make booking the staff explained that the price for teeth cleaning is 800 to 1200 Bahts, the lower price is for easy and simple good teeth while the higher price is for relatively "difficult to clean" not so good teeth. Mine is the latter taken about 12-15 minutes, and my wife's is the former taken less than probably 8 minutes. However, we were billed the same highest 1200 Bahts. Having pointed out and disputed with the staff, the bill was finally rectified to 1200 Bahts for me and 800 Bahts for my wife.

Further follow up ;
Yesterday, the young man who did the teeth cleaning for me told me I have 3 teeth with 5  decay that need filling. The offered cost is 800 Bahts for each filling, total 4000 Bahts. I had my teeth cleaning and checking about 1.5 years ago in Bangkok and didn't feel anything bad. I doubted how could so many tooth decay occurred so fast and therefore rejected his offer.
In order to double-check my teeth, I went to another reputable dental clinic with high google rating. The place is clean and well maintained, the dentist is professional and very attentive to my concern. After my explanation, she examined thoroughly and concluded that my teeth are fine and no need to pay unnecessarily for any filling.
Responding to my concern, she suggested conducting an X ray examination. The result reaffirmed her conclusion.

It's quite obvious that the young man from Canny Smile is not only unprofessional but dishonest trying to cheat money, probably especially from non-local, non-Thai customers.
